# Progeni Bench — Free Private Browser File Utilities

> Progeni Bench (https://bench.progeni.live) is a fast, 100% client-side web utility suite featuring 30 free file tools. All processing executes locally inside the user's web browser using HTML5 Canvas, Web Cryptography, and WebAssembly. Zero files, images, or documents are uploaded to external servers.

## Core Values & Privacy Guarantee
- 100% Client-Side Processing: All file transformations occur in local browser memory (RAM).
- Zero Uploads: Sensitive CSVs, personal photos, contact databases, and calendar files never touch a remote server.
- Free & No Registration: Unlimited access to all 30 utility tools without signup or ads.

## Tool Categories & Key Capabilities

### 1. Print & Craft Utilities
- Sticker Sheet Maker (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/sticker-sheet/): Tile images onto US Letter / A4 sticker grids for Cricut & Silhouette printers.
- Avery 5160 / Label Maker (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/labels/): Format contact lists into printable mailing labels.
- T-Shirt Print Mirror (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/tshirt-mirror/): Flip illustrations horizontally for iron-on transfer paper printing.
- Iron-on Transfer Sheet Maker (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/ironon-sheet/): Arrange multiple mirrored graphics on printable heat transfer sheets.
- Print Layout Optimizer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/print-layout/): Optimize paper usage by nesting graphic elements onto custom page sizes.
- Photo Print Border Calculator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/print-border/): Calculate exact mat framing borders and print margins.

### 2. Craft & Needlework
- Cross-Stitch Pattern Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/cross-stitch/): Convert photographs into DMC color-coded grid charts.
- Diamond Painting Grid Calculator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/diamond-painting/): Generate drill count matrices and color maps for diamond embroidery.
- Embroidery Thread Estimator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/embroidery/): Calculate skein requirements from stitch counts.

### 3. Video & Audio Utilities
- Video Title Safe Zone Overlay (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/video-safe-zone/): Preview 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 social media action and title safe boundaries.
- Video Thumbnail Comparison (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/video-thumbnails/): Compare YouTube/TikTok thumbnail candidates side-by-side.
- Audio Podcast Chapter Editor (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/audio-chapters/): Edit and export MP3/AAC chapter markers into clean text format.
- Audio Silence Map Visualizer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/silence-map/): Map quiet sections in voice recordings to trim dead air.
- Subtitle Speed & CPS Analyzer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/subtitle-speed/): Audit SRT/VTT subtitle reading speeds and characters per second.
- Subtitle Line Break Fixer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/subtitle-linefix/): Automatically format long subtitle lines into readable 2-line blocks.

### 4. Data & Contact Tools
- Contact Database Deduplicator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/contact-dedupe/): Deduplicate CSV/vCard contact lists by phone and email.
- CSV File Splitter (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/csv-splitter/): Split multi-gigabyte CSV spreadsheets by line count or file size.
- CSV Date Format Converter (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/csv-date/): Standardize ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD date columns across databases.
- vCard QR & Contact Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/vcard/): Build VCF contact cards and scan-to-save QR codes locally.
- Bookmark Clean & Audit (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/bookmark-cleaner/): Clean duplicate URLs and broken links from HTML browser bookmark exports.
- Reading List Manager (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/bookmark-reading/): Organize browser bookmarks into categorized reading queues.
- SVG Asset Cleaner & Optimizer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/svg-cleaner/): Strip metadata, comments, and unused attributes from SVG graphics.
- iCal / Calendar Event Cleaner (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/calendar-cleaner/): Sanitize ICS calendar feeds by stripping private notes and duplicate events.
- Timetable to iCal Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/timetable-calendar/): Convert class or work schedules into importable .ics files.

### 5. Image & Photo Tools
- Smartphone Wallpaper Cropper (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/wallpaper/): Center-crop photographs to 9:19.5 mobile phone display ratios.
- Panorama Carousel Splitter (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/panorama/): Slice wide panoramic photos into 3 seamless square Instagram carousel tiles.
- Photo Duplicate Finder (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/duplicate-finder/): Detect exact duplicate images using local SHA-256 binary hashing.
- Photo Best-Shot Finder (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/best-shot/): Rank burst photo sets by sharpness and contrast using Laplacian edge gradients.
- Photo Timeline Builder (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/photo-timeline/): Sort photo collections chronologically into offline HTML event galleries.
- Family Photo Date Organizer (https://bench.progeni.live/tools/family-organizer/): Group family photos by date and create structured timeline indices.

## Bench Image Toolkit
> A registry-driven, 100% client-side image workspace at https://bench.progeni.live/image/ with 39 working tools plus a batch Image Studio. Every tool runs locally in the browser using Canvas and File APIs; no image is ever uploaded. Tools without a real client-side handler are labelled unavailable or deferred instead of faking output.

- Image Toolkit Hub (https://bench.progeni.live/image/): Browse every working image tool by category.
- Image Studio (https://bench.progeni.live/image/studio/): Multi-file batch resize, convert, rename and ZIP export.
- Image Compressor (https://bench.progeni.live/image/compress/): Re-encode JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF with real before/after byte sizes.
- Compress to Target Size (https://bench.progeni.live/image/compress-to-size/): Binary-search quality to fit a target file size.
- Resize Image (https://bench.progeni.live/image/resize/): Exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio locking.
- Crop Image (https://bench.progeni.live/image/crop/): Ratio-locked cropping with a focal point.
- Application Photo & Signature Presets (https://bench.progeni.live/image/application-photo/): Configurable starting dimensions for passport/visa style photos (no authority guarantee).
- Social Media & YouTube Image Sizes (https://bench.progeni.live/image/social-resize/): Preset canvas sizes for social and YouTube artwork.
- DPI Inspector & Setter (https://bench.progeni.live/image/dpi/): Read and rewrite PNG/JPEG DPI without re-encoding pixels.
- Image Converter (https://bench.progeni.live/image/convert/): Convert between JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, ICO and GIF.
- Image to PDF (https://bench.progeni.live/image/image-to-pdf/): Raster pages assembled into a PDF (not searchable text).
- Base64 & Data URI Converter (https://bench.progeni.live/image/base64/): Encode/decode images and data URIs locally.
- Rotate, Flip & Straighten (https://bench.progeni.live/image/transform/): Rotate, flip and straighten images.
- Colour Adjustments (https://bench.progeni.live/image/adjust/): Brightness, contrast, saturation and more.
- Blur, Pixelate & Redact (https://bench.progeni.live/image/blur-redact/): Obscure regions before sharing.
- Text, Captions & Annotations (https://bench.progeni.live/image/annotate/): Add captions and annotations.
- Border, Padding & Rounded Corners (https://bench.progeni.live/image/border-padding/): Frame, pad or round image corners.
- Visible Watermark (https://bench.progeni.live/image/watermark/): Apply a visible text or image watermark.
- Meme Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/meme/): Classic top/bottom caption memes.
- Collage Maker (https://bench.progeni.live/image/collage/): Grid collages from multiple images.
- Image Splitter & Grid Cutter (https://bench.progeni.live/image/splitter/): Cut images into tiles and ZIP them.
- Side-by-Side Image Merge (https://bench.progeni.live/image/merge/): Combine images horizontally or vertically.
- Image Compare & Similarity (https://bench.progeni.live/image/compare/): Perceptual similarity between two images.
- Product Photo Shadow & Background (https://bench.progeni.live/image/product-shadow/): Add shadows and clean backgrounds for listings.
- Metadata & EXIF Viewer (https://bench.progeni.live/image/metadata-viewer/): Inspect EXIF, GPS and embedded metadata.
- EXIF & GPS Remover (https://bench.progeni.live/image/strip-metadata/): Strip metadata for privacy.
- Image Hash Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/image-hash/): SHA-256 and perceptual hashes for images.
- Duplicate & Similar Photo Finder (https://bench.progeni.live/image/duplicate-finder/): Find exact and near-duplicate photos locally.
- Colour Palette & Histogram (https://bench.progeni.live/image/palette/): Extract dominant colours and histograms.
- Favicon & App Icon Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/favicon/): Generate favicon and app icon sets as a ZIP.
- Open Graph Image Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/og-image/): Compose 1200x630 social share images.
- QR Code Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/qr-code/): Create QR codes locally.
- QR Code Reader (https://bench.progeni.live/image/qr-decode/): Decode QR codes from images.
- Barcode Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/barcode/): Generate 1D barcodes (CODE128, EAN and more).
- SVG Optimizer & Validator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/svg-optimizer/): Validate and sanitise SVG safely.
- Image Placeholder Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/placeholder/): Generate placeholder images.
- Responsive Image srcset Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/srcset/): Produce responsive srcset variants as a ZIP.
- GIF Studio: Create & Extract (https://bench.progeni.live/image/gif-studio/): Build GIFs from frames or extract frames from GIFs.
- Sprite Sheet Generator (https://bench.progeni.live/image/sprite-sheet/): Pack frames into a sprite sheet plus metadata.
- Batch Rename & Export (https://bench.progeni.live/image/batch-rename/): Rename and export many images as a ZIP.
- Image Inspector & Diagnostics (https://bench.progeni.live/image/inspection/): Byte-level inspection without full decoding.
